messages:
anya: heads-up team: change window starts in 8m for v3.14. launching a small canary for embed routes. i'll post a rolling health snapshot here and call if we need to pause. :mag:

deploy-bot: AUTO: initiating canary group alpha -> 4% traffic. running baseline probes: embed_p95, route_5xx, kvcache_hit, model_worker_rss. snapshot will follow.

jules: noted. ran a quick local smoke earlier, saw occasional 502s against the new worker image under burst. filing to watch.

observability-bot: SYNTHETIC: /status/ready 200 in 150ms (baseline 130ms).

ryan: reminder on the SOP: canary auto-pause if `route_5xx >= 0.5%` OR `p95 delta >= +180ms` sustained for 2m. manual pause criteria are more conservative.

kevin-m: querying kv cache stats. current miss-rate = 5.4%. if that drifts > 9% we'll consider enabling the prefix-cache override.

deploy-bot: LIVE: canary now at 10% after initial ramp. metrics: `embed_p95=175ms`, `embed_5xx=0.09%`, `kv_miss=5.6%`, `worker_rss=1.8GB`. No auto-pause.

anya: thanks. jules/kevin, watch embed p95 and worker RSS for the next 12m. i'll keep the thread as the canonical deploy log.

jules: running targeted perf test now with modest qps. command: `./ops/probe --routes=embed --duration=3m --qps=50`.

jules: quick results: p95 climbed to 210ms in one minute bucket, 5xx stayed under 0.2%. that's above our p95 soft threshold (180ms) but below auto-pause.

ryan: since p95 is drifting, two options: pin embed-route back to v3.13 or apply a short-term mitigation on canary (throttle, pool size tweak, or circuit-breaker). i'm leaning mitigation + hold to avoid churn.

anya: agree, do a short-term mitigation. jules, can you try reducing model-worker concurrency by 25% on canary nodes and flip on the temporary cb (circuit-breaker) for external upstreams? We'll observe for 5m. Document the change in the release notes.

jules: applying `FEATURE_FLAG:worker_concurrency_reduced=true` to canary and enabling `cb.upstream=temporal`. patch going to 3 nodes now.

observability-bot: ALERT (info): embed-route p95 deviation +60ms across regions. link: https://internal.obsv/redwood/release/v3.14/embed. rule: release_watch_embed.

kevin-m: logs show a handful of OOM-kicks on one canary node around T+6m, likely due to model-worker memory spikes. lowering concurrency should help.

deploy-bot: UPDATE: canary hold extended +8m per request from anya. traffic remains at 10%.

jules: after concurrency reduction: `embed_p95=158ms`, `embed_5xx=0.06%`, `kv_miss=5.7%`, `worker_rss=1.5GB`. much improved.

ryan: that's a clear improvement. recommend we keep the mitigation in place until GA; add a follow-up to revert and run a mem-stress regression test in CI. also add a short-term alert: `if embed_p95 > 240ms OR embed_5xx > 0.5% for 3m -> pause`.

anya: done. i've updated the changeboard entry with the mitigation note and flagged it as `temporary-hotpatch`. pinned the canary config to `v3.14-canary-hotpatch-20260321` for auditability. release notes now mention the concurrency flag.

kevin-m: i'll keep watching kvcache and memory; planning to increase kv cache TTL on canary if miss-rate creeps above 8%.

jules: creating a short-lived ops dashboard: `ops dash create --name "embed v3.14 hotpatch" --metrics embed_p95,embed_5xx,kv_miss,worker_rss`

observability-bot: MONITOR: temporary rule `embed_v3_14_hotpatch` created (p95/5xx 3m window).

anya: next step: ramp to 35% in 4m if no regression. please shout immediately if you see any new 5xx clusters or sustained p95 spikes.

deploy-bot: PROGRESS: ramping to 35% started. scaling nodes: 3 -> 14.

jules: post-ramp sample: `embed_p95=162ms`, `embed_5xx=0.08%`, `kv_miss=6.0%`. solid. :thumbsup:

ryan: good signal. leave the mitigation on for now and schedule a follow-up to bake proper autoscaling and mem-guard logic. we'll avoid rollback unless multiple regions show >0.5% 5xx.

anya: agreed. i'll leave thread open for 10m and then close if stable. final note: adding a ticket to add a canary-specific regression harness that simulates model_worker mem pressure.

deploy-bot: FINAL STATUS (in 8m): rollout completed to 100% with hotpatch mitigation in place. no auto-pauses triggered. tagging for post-deploy infra follow-up.

anya: closing — mitigation worked, no rollback. follow-ups: revert concurrency flag on maintenance window, add mem-stress CI test, and consider a config knob to auto-scale model-worker rss thresholds. thanks all. :party:
